title: Freeness of Arrangements with Regular Underlying Matroids
summary: We classify freeness for finite central arrangements whose underlying matroids are regular. Let $\mathcal A$ be such an arrangement over an arbitrary field, and put $M=M(\mathcal A)$. Then $\mathcal A$ is free if and only if $M$ is supersolvable; equivalently, $M$ admits a nice partition; equivalently, $M$ is the cycle matroid of a chordal simple graph. Thus, for arrangements with regular underlying matroids, freeness has a complete combinatorial classification independent of the base field.
